mapper.select: SELECT w.workspace_id FROM workspaces w JOIN workspace_domains d ON w.workspace_id = d.workspace_id WHERE d.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND d.active = 'Y'
mapper.sql: (SELECT md.name FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id WHERE pm.project_id = p.project_id AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role = ( SELECT MAX(role) FROM project_members WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND status = 0 ) AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS pm_name
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_members WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND status = 0 ) AS member_count
mapper.select:
SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, ,
FROM projects p ORDER BY project_id DESC

SELECT p.project_id, p.workspace_id, p.subject, p.content, TO_CHAR(p.start_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS start_date, TO_CHAR(p."END", 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, p.archive, TO_CHAR(p.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS created, ,
FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH FIRST #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT NVL(COUNT(*), 0) FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND p.deleted IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_projects.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO projects(project_id, workspace_id, subject, content, start_at, "END", status, progress, archive, created) VALUES (seq_projects.NEXTVAL, #{workspace_id}, #{subject}, #{content}, TO_DATE(#{start_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), TO_DATE(#{end_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{status}, #{progress}, 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND archive = 'N'

SELECT p.project_id, p.subject, p.content, p.start_at AS start_date, p.end AS end_date, p.status, p.progress, ,
FROM projects p WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId}

SELECT p.project_id AS id, p.subject AS title FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND (p.project_id > #{id}) AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT p.project_id , p.subject FROM projects p JOIN workspace_domains wd ON p.workspace_id = wd.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND (p.project_id < #{id}) AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.project_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
